Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of PtRu/PC and Pt/PC nanocatalysts (Fig. 1A) show the five dominant peaks at 2θ = 39.7°, 46.2°, 67.5°, 81.2° and 85.7° corresponding to the (111), (200), (220), (311) and (222) planes of Pt face-centered cubic (fcc) structure. The TEM images and the corresponding size distribution histograms (Fig. 2) of PtRu/PC–H, PtRu/PC-L, and Pt/PC samples further confirm the crystal plane indices and the characterization methods used.
